content_sections.heading: Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026: Project Wise Vacancy Details (389 Posts)
content_sections.text: A total of 389 vacant posts (150 posts of Anganwadi workers and 239 posts of Anganwadi assistants) have been notified in 14 Child Development Projects of Fatehpur district . The Gram Sabha/Ward-wise details of the above posts and the complete eligibility details including reservation have been posted on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil and Vikas Khand offices of the district, and it is also uploaded on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in. The number of category-wise reservations (SC/ST/OBC/General) is not given separately in this notification; candidates should refer to the above website or notice board for complete details regarding reservation.

content_sections.heading: Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026: Eligibility and Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: The minimum educational qualification for both the posts of Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Assistant will be Intermediate (12th) passed or its equivalent. Gender Restriction: Only female candidates will be eligible for these posts .

content_sections.heading: Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026: Residence Requirement
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a permanent resident of the ward/village council for which the vacant position is located. If the relevant village council does not have eligible candidates in the above category, they must be a permanent resident of the respective Panchayat .

content_sections.heading: Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Regarding age, only the date of birth listed in your high school mark sheet and certificate will be considered for the Anganwadi worker and Anganwadi assistant positions. This release does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in . Read the detailed notification and application related information available on the website carefully, and get the information regarding vacant posts, eligibility and reservation as per your ward/Gram Sabha/Nyaya Panchayat from the notice board or website. Fill the online application form available on the website within the stipulated time period. Fill all the information asked in the application (educational qualification, date of birth, residence proof etc.) correctly. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: This is a recruitment notification issued by the District Program Officer, Fatehpur, under which online applications have been invited for direct recruitment to a total of 389 vacant posts of Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Assistant in 14 Child Development Projects of Fatehpur district.

faq.question: Q2. How many total posts are there in Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 389 posts – 150 posts of Anganwadi workers and 239 posts of Anganwadi assistants, which are distributed in Devmai, Bhitaura, Malwan, Asothar, Airayan, Haswan, Shahar, Vijayipur, Dhata, Hathgam, Teliani, Amouli, Khajuha and Bahua project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 17th September 2026, up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Assistant posts is Intermediate (12th) pass or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The applicant must be at least 18 years old and no more than 35 years old as of July 1, 2026. Regarding age, only the date of birth indicated in the high school mark sheet and certificate will be valid.

faq.question: Q6. Can male candidates apply for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: No, only female candidates will be eligible for the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for Fatehpur Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: Applications can only be made through the online form on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed timeframe. Offline applications will not be accepted.
